findings.label: Unpublished drafts viewable anonymously
findings.description: GetBlogBySlug returns a post regardless of IsPublished, and removing the guard lets a guest reach /blogs/:slug; gate non-published posts behind auth or restrict the anonymous single-fetch to published posts.

findings.label: Unauthenticated, un-rate-limited clap endpoint
findings.description: POST /api/blogs/{id}/clap has no [Authorize] and no effective rate limiting, and is now reachable by anonymous readers from the detail page; add auth or apply the rate limiter to it.
